description: Main source file for a WebKit browser extension, handling initialization, JavaScript injection, message handling, and connection setup within the WPEFramework environment.

classes.name: PluginHost
classes.description: Manages the WebKit extension lifecycle, connection setup, JavaScript injection, and message handling within the WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: GetConnectionNode
methods.description: Retrieves the connection node ID from environment variables.

methods.name: PluginHost::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the extension, sets up connections, and injects JavaScript into web pages.

methods.name: PluginHost::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disconnects from the environment.

methods.name: windowObjectClearedCallback
methods.description: Injects JavaScript when the window object is cleared.

methods.name: pageCreatedCallback
methods.description: Handles new page creation, sets up message and request handlers.

methods.name: consoleMessageSentCallback
methods.description: Logs console messages from the web page.

methods.name: userMessageReceivedCallback
methods.description: Handles messages received from the web page, such as headers or bridge object messages.

methods.name: sendRequestCallback
methods.description: Applies request headers before sending network requests.

methods.name: didStartProvisionalLoadForFrame
methods.description: Handles the start of provisional page loads, unloads JS bindings if main frame.
